charge_port.notes: Estimated: CCS1 (J1772 native inlet) through the 2026 model year: press pages for this model line state CCS1 for 2024-2026 and NACS from 2027. Same port assumed for the Canadian car (Guide Auto 2024-09-18: Canadian owners need the GM adapter). Model year 2025.

supercharger_access.notes: Estimated: GM adapter programme covers Blazer EV, Equinox EV, Silverado EV and LYRIQ (Canadian article); US availability assumed. Current state for model year 2025: adapter needed. Markets: US.
US press: an InsideEVs author charged a 2025 Blazer EV SS at a Tesla Supercharger in California with the Chevy-approved adapter (2025-05-30). US market, model year 2025: adapter needed.
